description: Save session context before ending work or when significant progress is made. Records what was accomplished, decisions made, and what should happen next. This ensures the next AI session (in any tool) can pick up seamlessly.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during this session that should carry forward

decisions.description: Key decisions made during this session (e.g., "chose JWT over sessions for stateless API")

resolutions.description: Resolved items or conclusions reached during this session

summary.description: Brief summary of what was done in this session

name: mindswap_save_context
